title: Human Development - Lifespan Development Option
sourceText:
H D 101 [SSCI]

Quantitative Reasoning [QUAN]

UCORE Inquiry
Must complete 4 of these 5 UCORE designations: ARTS, BSCI, EQJS, HUM, PSCI. One lab science (BSCI or PSCI) must be completed.

Written Communication [WRTG]

Communication [COMM] or Written Communication [WRTG]

H D 204

HISTORY 105 [ROOT]

Elective
Electives must include sufficient 300-400-level coursework to meet the University requirement of 40 credits of upper-division coursework.

H D 220

H D 300, 301, or 302

Electives
Electives must include sufficient 300-400-level coursework to meet the University requirement of 40 credits of upper-division coursework.

H D 306, 307, 308, or 309

H D 350 [DIVR]

Lifespan H D Elective
Lifespan H D Electives (9 credits): Students must complete three courses from the WSU Catalog Human Development course listing, not used to complete other requirements.

Complete Writing Portfolio

H D 310 [M]

Lifespan H D Elective

H D 410 [M]

H D 497
H D 497 is required and must be completed prior to H D 498, but no more than two semesters before H D 498.

H D 498
The internship course (H D 498) is also available during the summer term of the junior or senior year. Students may take H D 498 for up to 9 credits. For students completing the Lifespan Development option, the H D 498 internship experience must focus on a field relevant to lifespan human development.

Integrative Capstone [CAPS]

Students can be admitted as a Human Development major after completing 24 credits and earning a GPA of at least 2.0.  A cumulative GPA of 2.6 or better in all H D courses that apply to the option, including substitutions is required to (a) maintain admission in the major; and (b) complete the Bachelor of Arts degree in Human Development. Of the 48 H D credits required for the major and Lifespan Development option, a minimum of 21 must be taken at WSU.
